steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: You want... my family?
It doesn't take long for the girl's expression to change from innocent and carefree to shocked and perplexed, before finally molding into a frown of indescribable pain.
Not far away, the wind begins to rage, and the waves begin to roar.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...Where are you going to take them? What... are you going to do to them?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You look really perplexed. Did you remember something?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you remember where your real family went? Do you remember what happened to them?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Ahhh!

With a sudden shudder, Roulecca covers her head and slumps to the ground. Her "father" instinctively lunges forward to catch her in his arms, while the other four-leaf clovers rush over to pin you down.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Daddy... Lucy... Everyone is here... Everyone is fine... Everyone is by Roulecca's side... Daddy didn't leave Roulecca... Daddy has always been by my side...
The four-leaf clover doesn't reply. He just hugs her tightly and supports her as best he can. Small pieces of black four-leaf clovers begin to float out of Roulecca's mouth and dissolve into the air.
You know those are fragments of her pain being driven back to reality. Ambrosia always expels Roulecca's memories before she manages to remember anything. This must have happened many times already.
You have to take a gamble to break the cycle.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...Hehe... You've got guts, mister... To want Roulecca's family...
steps.female_content: ...Hehe... You've got guts, lady... To want Roulecca's family...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Who do you think you are?!
Your skin begins to crack and shed pieces of black four-leaf clovers, which float away and disappear. A tingling pain seeps through your body.
Roulecca is rejecting you. Her subconscious is trying to squeeze you out of the dream, but you can't back down.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: No cheating. You don't have the confidence to beat me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come beat me in the game. Lucky Roulecca, daughter of the four-leaf clovers, don't break your own rules!
She glances at her father, who looks back at her, as if silently reminding her of something.
Finally, the girl lowers her head, clenches her teeth, and glares at you.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I'll win against you fair and square.
The resentment expelling you disappears. The girl staggers up to face you, surrounded by a black shroud of shredded four-leaf clovers.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You won't beat me by playing house.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not like your "family." I won't coddle you, and you won't get any "good luck" from me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you want to win against me, then wake up from this dream and remember what you have discarded, Sinner Roulecca.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...Hehe, hahahaha... A villain, what a villain you are...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Roulecca is not a Sinner. Roulecca is just the daughter of the four-leaf clovers. No one can split up the clovers. No one can take away Roulecca's family.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I hate you, but I won't lose to you.
She grabs onto the corner of her father's shirt.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Daddy... You're on Roulecca's side, aren't you? You won't leave me, will you, Daddy?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: ...Of course. Daddy will always be on Roulecca's side.
The four-leaf clover father hugs Roulecca. The pair walks to the other side of the net and turns to face you. You know he won't go easy on you.
